title: Jenkins vs GitHub Actions: Same Pipeline in Both Tools
title_es: Jenkins vs GitHub Actions: el mismo pipeline en ambas herramientas
description: The same Node.js CI pipeline implemented twice: a declarative Jenkinsfile and an equivalent GitHub Actions workflow, with a concept-mapping guide.
description_es: El mismo pipeline CI de Node.js implementado dos veces: un Jenkinsfile declarativo y un workflow equivalente de GitHub Actions, con guía de mapeo de conceptos.
